description: Shared implementation of vectorized reduced-precision types (bfloat16 and float16) for ARM NEON, including vector operations, blending, arange, mathematical functions, and utility methods.

classes.name: Vectorized16
classes.description: Template class providing vectorized operations for reduced-precision floating point types using CRTP.

methods.name: map2
methods.description: Applies a binary function element-wise to two vectors and returns the result.

methods.name: blend
methods.description: Creates a blended vector based on a mask.

methods.name: arange
methods.description: Generates a range of values starting from a base with a specified step.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses an element by index (slow implementation).

methods.name: zero_mask
methods.description: Returns a mask indicating which elements are zero.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Applies a unary function to each element.

methods.name: angle
methods.description: Computes the angle (phase) of the vector.
